new_candidates.legal_basis: Ordinance EC26-18 (Edmonson County Fiscal Court), an ordinance imposing a temporary moratorium on data centers, AI facilities, and cryptocurrency mining operations
new_candidates.trigger: County-wide pause adopted to allow study of infrastructure, public-safety, land-use, environmental, and quality-of-life effects of data centers, AI facilities, and cryptocurrency mining before any such facility could be permitted.
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31; enacted June 8, 2026 for a one-year term. Bars new permits, licenses, rezonings, approvals, construction, expansion, and operation of covered facilities; existing lawful facilities and ordinary commercial computer use are excluded.
new_candidates.affected_projects: Not identified in reviewed sources; ordinance is prospective and covers new data centers, AI facilities, and cryptocurrency mining operations.
new_candidates.outcome: Adopted; in effect through approximately 2027-06-08 absent earlier Fiscal Court action.
